provenance.source: accepted Plan 13 race-physics.mjs; in-memory adapter only; physics constants unchanged
provenance.selectedRulesPreserved: same rank-weave/contact experiment, seed keys, course geometry, acceleration, braking, accepted corner-target search and turn law, contact and finish logic; only sampled topSpeed conversion differs
provenance.comparison: sqrt10.45 baseline vs. identity linear conversion, then one calibration-selected linear conversion; no 8–12 topSpeed clamp on either linear arm
provenance.threshold: finish >23s is the one-sided late-tail criterion; median target 17–23s; under-17s finishes are permitted. An unresolved attempt is separately counted and included as conservative late-or-unresolved outcome.
provenance.inputOrder: roster rating × rest factor × one-time trial factor × stance/sample draw; then model conversion
provenance.highlight: simulation finish time is reported separately from +2s presentation playback

sqrt10_45.capTreatment: mapped output stays inside the accepted 8–12 top-speed range; Plan 13 corner-target search is unchanged
